text: Putin LIVE | Putin GANGS UP With Trump Over Greenland| Putin EXPLODES At NATO, EU| US-Russia Vs NATORussia’s President Vladimir Putin appears to align with Donald Trump in stunning attack on Denmark and NATO over the Greenland controversy. In a rare and provocative intervention, Putin accuses Denmark of treating Greenland like a colony, calling Copenhagen’s rule “harsh” while distancing Moscow from the dispute.
